Home.headline: One system for the whole job.
Home.subhead: Intake, inspection, approval, work on the floor, hours, parts, and invoice — without retyping anything.
Home.bayTitle: Jobs the way the shop runs — digital.
Home.baySub: Plate, work, and status at a glance. No whiteboard. No sticky notes.
Home.step1Body: Customer and vehicle stay on the same file. Your checklists, status per item, licence-plate/RDW lookup. Findings feed the quote — no second inventory.
Home.step2Body: Work plan from the inspection plus your services library. Printable PDF in the shop, or a secure link with signature and timestamp. Then the customer picks a slot.
Home.step3Body: Work order from the approved plan. Timer or manual hours, parts and consumables. Invoice from the same rules — pro forma or final.
Home.portalBody: Customers sign the quote, then pick an appointment slot (no cold self-booking), follow the repair, and download the invoice. Online pay if you connected Mollie or Tikkie.
Home.portalImageAlt: Technician working in a garage workshop
Home.rolesSub: Everyone works in one system — with exactly the tools their role needs.
Home.roleBackBody: Customers, inspection, quotes, planning, hour approval, and invoicing — no Excel islands.
Home.roleTechBody: Own dashboard and schedule. Work order, inspection on the floor, timer or manual hours, photos on the line.
Home.roleCustBody: Sign the quote, pick a slot after approval, follow status, download the invoice — via login or a secure link.
Home.finalCtaTitle: Ready to run the whole job in one system?
Home.finalCtaBody: Sign up. You get a trial, then onboarding with company details, rates, and logo.

Features.title: Everything the shop needs
Features.intro: Office, technician, and customer portal — one chain from intake to invoice.
Features.storyTitle: The Golf is outside. Brakes squeal.
Features.storyIntro: The real flow: inspection → quote → approval → floor → invoice. Customer, car, and job stay the same chain.
Features.beat1Body: Your own inspection checklists: sections, items, order. Per item OK, attention, urgent, or n/a plus a note. Save as draft, finalize, then read-only. Findings carry into the quote.
Features.beat2Body: A work plan with multiple lines, built from the inspection and your services library. Printable PDF for an in-shop signature, or a secure link with signature and timestamp — by email.
Features.beat3Body: Work order from the approved plan. Assign and schedule technicians. The customer picks a slot from the same shop capacity. Timer (one running) or manual hours, photos on the line.
Features.beat4Body: Approve or reject hours (with a reason). Then a pro forma or final invoice from hours, parts, and consumables. PDF download via a secure link — no attachment by default.
Features.grid1: From inspection to invoice, one file
Features.audienceTitle: Office, bay, and customer — each their own screen.
Features.officeItem1: Customer file and vehicles (plate, make, model, year), including RDW/APK lookup
Features.officeItem2: Your own inspection checklists and a status report per vehicle
Features.officeItem3: Quote and work plan from the inspection plus the services library
Features.officeItem4: Work order, schedule technicians, traffic-light / capacity on the dashboard
Features.officeItem5: Approve hours, pro forma and invoice, CSV and UBL export
Features.officeItem6: Product catalog, stock movements, large parts on the job, consumables as a % of labor (default 8%)
Features.officeItem7: Onboarding, invite the team, APK and invoice reminders, activity log
Features.officeItem8: Office vs technician roles, MFA, privacy export or anonymize, each shop sees only its own data
Features.techItem1: Own dashboard: today’s work, no office noise
Features.techItem2: Own schedule and a work order with customer, car, and lines
Features.techItem3: Run the inspection on the floor, close out steps
Features.techItem4: Timer (one running timer) or manual hours — large buttons, built for the pit
Features.techItem5: Photos and video on a work line
Features.techItem6: Attendance, break, and busy on the workday
Features.custItem1: Log in or open via a secure link
Features.custItem2: View the quote and sign digitally
Features.custItem3: Pick an appointment slot after approval — no cold self-booking off the street
Features.custItem4: Follow repair status, without internal notes
Features.custItem5: View inspections, vehicles, and the invoice; download the PDF
Features.custItem6: Pay online when the shop has connected Mollie or Tikkie
Features.integrationsBody: Online payments with Mollie or Tikkie. Accounting with Exact Online, Moneybird, or e-Boekhouden. Invoice export as CSV and UBL. Not on by default for everyone — you enable what your shop uses.

Pricing.intro: Try it for 30 days. Then monthly or yearly by invoice — not yet collected in the app.
Pricing.trialNote: No required demo call. A second shop: its own registration + wizard.
Pricing.planBody: For the Dutch shop that wants the whole job in one file.
Pricing.planInc2: Customer portal: approve, book, track, pay
Pricing.planInc6: Dutch invoice (KvK, VAT, IBAN, PDF, CSV/UBL)
Pricing.planInc8: Connectable with Mollie, Tikkie, Exact, Moneybird, e-Boekhouden

Pricing.enterpriseLink: Questions about your shop or onboarding? Contact us →
Pricing.included1Body: New features without separate upgrade fees.
Pricing.included2Body: Email support on business days, NL/EN.
Pricing.included3Body: Secure cloud hosting and backups. Each shop sees only its own data.

Pricing.faq1A: Sign up. After email confirmation you go through onboarding (company details, rates, logo, go-live checklist). You get a 30-day trial.
Pricing.faq2A: Monthly or yearly by invoice (iDEAL / bank transfer). Not yet via in-app collection. Yearly = 10× the monthly price.
Pricing.faq3A: Monthly: cancel up to 14 days before renewal. Yearly: runs to the end of the term.
Pricing.faq4A: Yes, when your shop has connected Mollie or Tikkie. Without that connection, payment stays outside the app.

About.title: Built for Dutch repair shops
About.intro: GarageApp is an Innovolabs product — made to replace Excel/Access workflows without disrupting the floor.
About.storyBody: One chain: customer → car → inspection → quote → work order → hours → parts → invoice. Built for Dutch garages: VAT, KvK, APK, consumables. Dutch first, English available. Your shop, your data.
About.value1: Dutch-first — UI and processes for the local market, including invoice identity.
About.value2: One source of truth — inspection through invoice linked, without retyping.
About.value3: Customer transparency — approve, book, track, pay, without internal notes.

Privacy.title: Privacy
Privacy.p1: Innovolabs (“we”) process personal data you share via this website or GarageApp to answer contact requests and deliver the service.
Privacy.p2: Contact form data (name, email, message) is used only to respond. We do not sell data to third parties.
Privacy.p3: For the SaaS environment, separate processor terms apply with customer garages (tenants). Each shop sees only its own data. Ask us for the current DPA.
Privacy.p4: In the app, shops can submit export and delete or anonymize requests. For access, correction, or deletion via this website: use the form or the email on this site.
Privacy.p5: This page is a stub and is not legal advice. We’ll update it when production domain and DPA are final.
